items.summary: Legal risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, or advertising. Official Woot documentation establishes API access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data; current public terms point against the proposed use. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only, keep outreach unsent, and permit only bounded read-only evidence work.

Ordinary reversible growth is conditional, not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry, if it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked where evidence is incomplete. Technical compliance is not certification: 37 sites pass, 16 fail, and 6 are unknown; analytics is yellow, revenue attribution is partial, and operations/security sweeps are unavailable.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks are closed and 4 remain open. No task is closed because direct evidence is still missing. Continue the existing evidence bundle. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only artifact covering field-level rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence; then route rights and jurisdictional gaps to human counsel.

Private-site decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each property covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence by 2026-09-30T17:00Z; escalate incomplete packets to CTO.
